messages:
alex_infra: FYI started seeing a wave of tiny-gang GPU pods in ap-southeast1 entering Pending -> scheduled -> immediate eviction since ~09:12 UTC. Pattern looks like gang-affinity mismatch.

sam_scheduler: Any node label examples?

alex_infra: grabbed a couple: node-aps-3 -> gpu.slot.twin=slot-A, node-aps-7 -> gpu.slot.twin=slot_A (underscore). Scheduler expects exact match so gang placement flips.
maria_ops: That would cause churn and retry cost. Can we hotfix?
sam_scheduler: Options: 1) short-term scheduler predicate normalizer (replace '_' -> '-') behind feature flag. 2) rollout daemonset that rewrites node labels to canonical form. 3) admission webhook long-term.

infra-bot: [ALERT] evictions-ap-southeast1 > 10/min — INC-20260321-142 created.

alex_infra: rolling DS label-normalizer to cluster-ops namespace now (image: registry.internal/label-normalizer:stable). Script: kubectl get nodes -l gpu=true -o name | xargs -n1 kubectl label node --overwrite --batch-mode gpu.slot.twin=$(kubectl get node -o jsonpath='{.metadata.labels.gpu.slot.twin}' | sed 's/_/-/g')

sam_scheduler: I'll open a tiny PR for scheduler normalizer as fallback.
maria_ops: watch metrics and post cost delta.
alex_infra: DS canary applied to 25 nodes; evictions dropped from ~18/min to ~1/min in 7m. Marking mitigated, keeping incident open for 30m stabilization.

sam_scheduler: follow-ups: add label schema contract to provisioning and admission webhook work on roadmap.
